low.label: LOW
low.description: Weak hypothesis or sparse telemetry; high likelihood of alternative explanations.

moderate.label: MODERATE
moderate.description: Consistent indicative signals present; some gaps, ambiguities, or secondary contradictions remain.

high.label: HIGH
high.description: Strong corroborating evidence across independent technical sources with minimal contradiction.

very_high.label: VERY HIGH
very_high.description: Definitive multi-source corroboration with cryptographic verification or unanimous IoC overlap.

limitations.THREAT_CLASSIFICATION: Deterministic heuristic assessment based on observable indicators; zero-day or clean-reputation staging domains may initially score low.
limitations.INFRASTRUCTURE_ATTRIBUTION: Location refers to observed network infrastructure and should not be interpreted as the physical location of the threat actor.
limitations.CAMPAIGN_ASSOCIATION: Campaign clustering reflects observed technical IoC overlap across ingested cases; distinct actors occasionally deploy shared infrastructure.
limitations.GEOLOCATION: IP geolocation reflects autonomous system routing and data center points of presence, not the physical location of the human operator.
limitations.LOOKALIKE_DOMAIN: Lexical homoglyph and string-distance algorithm; does not consult official trademark registries or legal corporate entity databases.
limitations.MALICIOUS_URL: Static non-invasive structural inspection; click-time server-side cloaking or credential redirection chains may alter behavior.
limitations.NLP_CLASSIFICATION: Syntactic and psychological urgency cues from plain-text content; benign high-priority business emails may trigger urgency flags.
limitations.ATTACHMENT_VERDICT: Static file header and hash evaluation; encrypted or password-protected archives without supplied credentials cannot be inspected.
